fields.acceptance: A test in cmd/rhiza reads agents/developing.md and finds each lesson (testscript, scratchpad, RHIZA_ROOT, GOTMPDIR, root daemon, rhiza render); it and the agent-docs consistency test pass with go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run on their names
fields.statement: agents/developing.md, listed in agents/README.md, holds the lessons for any agent changing Rhiza's code: testscript gotchas ($WORK quoting, -count, chmod, stdin paths, fake binaries), build scratch binaries into the session scratchpad rather than a shared $TMPDIR path, unset RHIZA_ROOT, RHIZA_CHANGE and RHIZA_RUN before manual rhiza checks in scratch repos, override a run's GOTMPDIR so testscript $WORK stays outside the real repo, re-run web tests that see the root daemon from a scratch worktree, and run rhiza render after landed model writes

fields.acceptance: A test in cmd/rhiza reads agents/run-agents.md and finds each lesson (trailers in one paragraph, already-landed change set, empty commit, merge origin/main, ship json after a hand push); it and the agent-docs consistency test pass with go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run on their names
fields.statement: agents/run-agents.md, listed in agents/README.md, holds the lessons for builders, verifiers, checks and fixers working on Rhiza itself: Leaf:, Change: and Actor: trailers share the last paragraph with Co-Authored-By, run steps writing to the model handle a run change set that already landed, findings HEAD already fixes still get a new (empty) commit, a conflicting PR merges origin/main and is never rebased and force-pushed, and a hand push to a live run PR updates .git/rhiza/ship/<cs>.json

fields.acceptance: A test in cmd/rhiza reads agents/vm.md and finds each lesson (rhiza-root.service, maxRuns, the Rex pin, stray-logs, inject delay); it and the agent-docs consistency test pass with go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run on their names
fields.statement: agents/vm.md, listed in agents/README.md, holds the lessons for operating the VM that runs Rhiza's daemon: one root ~/code under rhiza-root.service, lower rhiza.daemon.maxRuns when load is high, the Rex package is pinned because Ubuntu's Perl rex package replaced it once, worktree resets move stray .rhiza/log entries to ~/orchestrator/stray-logs/, and flakes are reproduced by injecting delay, never by CPU load on the shared host
